spec: SPEC-6 vNext §2 step 6; single-writer image transition rules
description: An expected prior image is required for every replacement. New event orders must arrive in that replacement, and quota growth equals new non-order arrivals. Status-only updates preserve admission counters.

cases.name: status failure commits without new arrival
stale planned image cannot discard a newer fault
old held delta cannot become an effective order
cases.expected: new effective order lacks new arrival

cases.name: quota cannot jump without ordinary arrivals
cases.expected: quota growth must equal new ordinary arrivals

cases.name: initialization fails when image already exists
co-offered refused target cannot receive arrival
two orders for one target in one transfer need one event
cases.expected: target has two refusal events in one transfer

cases.name: two planned transfers for one target may batch in one image
one refusal event cannot mix order transfers
